tree.heading: Purpose.—
tree.text: Loyalty Day is a special day for the reaffirmation of loyalty to the United States and for the recognition of the heritage of American freedom.

tree.heading: Proclamation.—
tree.text: The President is requested to issue a proclamation—

children.text: calling on United States Government officials to display the flag of the United States on all Government buildings on Loyalty Day; and
inviting the people of the United States to observe Loyalty Day with appropriate ceremonies in schools and other suitable places.
